title: Per-slot price-forecast dispersion between the pre-gate and post-gate runs (field subset of phase 75)
derivation: A field subset. Every value is copied verbatim from phase75_decision_equivalence.json; nothing is recomputed. The commitment, nomination and profit quantities of that artefact belong to the companion manuscript and are deliberately absent here, which is why this file exists separately.
reading: Pooled-MAE equivalence within one price tick does not imply the two runs agree slot by slot. These are the per-slot differences that equivalence cannot bound, reported unconditionally.
